text:
marco: FYI partner reported duplicate side-effects (webhook fired twice) when using our Python async SDK with function/tool calling + structured returns.

marco: Minimal repro from partner sample app: async client, function_call='auto', default retry settings. They saw two tool invocations for a single user message.

marco: ```py
# tiny repro
from redwood import AsyncClient
import asyncio, os
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
async def go():
    await client.chat.create(
        model='rwd-1-3b',
        messages=[{'role':'user','content':'Trigger onboarding webhook for bob@example.com'}],
        tools=[{'name':'webhook_post','parameters':{'url':'string','payload':'object'},'returns':'application/json'}],
        function_call='auto'
    )
asyncio.run(go())
```

lee: Did their client retry due to a socket/read timeout? That often leads to at-least-once tool delivery.

marco: Exactly. Network trace shows first request reached runtime and triggered webhook. Client timed out waiting for full response and sent a second POST with a new request id. Server executed tool again.

anya: We should avoid automatic retries for requests that resulted in a function_call decision. Two-pronged plan: (1) SDK change to suppress retries after a tool decision unless caller opts in; (2) server-side dedupe keyed on a client-supplied id.

sam: For backwards compatibility, lets have SDK look for tool.metadata.invocation_uuid and, if present, forward it as an X-Invocation-Id header. Also add a convenience param on AsyncClient.create like allow_tool_retries=False by default.

lee: Agree. Also add a tiny helper in the sample app showing how to generate and attach invocation_uuid to tool.metadata (uuid4). Document that servers may ignore it until runtime supports dedupe.

marco: Short-term mitigations for partners: (A) disable SDK retries in PoC environment; (B) attach invocation_uuid to tool metadata and/or headers; (C) prefer returns='application/json' and explicit parsing so app logic can detect duplicate deliveries.

anya: I'll open an infra ticket to expose dedupe by X-Invocation-Id on the runtime side. That will let server reject duplicate tool invocations when the header matches an already-seen id.

sam: Tests: unit test verifying header is set when tool.metadata.invocation_uuid exists; integration simulating a stream timeout ensuring SDK suppressed the second attempt by default. Also log a warning when retry suppressed so partner teams can debug.

release-bot: created ticket 11500 (sdk: suppress retries after function_call + invocation id header) and tagged eng-runtime.

lee: Ok I'll draft a small sample-app PR and an SDK proposal doc for the behavioral change. Marco can link the partner repro and logs in the issue.

marco: Thanks — will post PR/issue links when ready.
